concept: Heirloom warmth for Beidelman Furniture: a rich walnut-brown primary grounds the brand in handcrafted, timeless furniture, warmed by an antique brass accent and balanced by a deep teal secondary. Creamy warm-white backgrounds and a charcoal ink keep the palette elegant, premium, and inviting.
contrastNotes: All WCAG-AA targets met. ink #2A2420 on bg #FBF7F0 = 14.34:1 (>=7). ink-soft #5C5048 on bg = 7.29:1 (>=4.5). White on primary #5A3E2B = 9.73:1 (>=4.5). primary on bg = 9.11:1 (>=3). Bonus: ink on surface-alt = 13.06:1; white on primary-dark = 13.52:1; white on secondary teal = 9.35:1. Brass accent #B08D3C is decorative/large-text only, not used for body text on light bg.
